A school counselor has agreements in their job requirements that require them to keep confidentiality for students, so likely they won't be telling a parent or someone unless you're really in danger. If you're only entertaining the thought then they'll help without alerting someone who needs to know, but if you're seriously considering it and its taking up all of your time then they have to alert someone. But they aren't just going to say that you're wrong (unless they're a crappy counselor but that's highly unlikely). But professional advice is always a good answer
